req.title: Reject invalid date-of-birth format
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 date.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject invalid date-of-birth formats with an HTTP 422 response. This is crucial for ensuring data integrity and preventing malformed data from entering the system. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior with valid input, a negative test to ensure invalid input is rejected, and a boundary test to check the system's response to edge cases.

tests.name: Valid Date of Birth Format
preconditions: The FastAPI application is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid ISO-8601 dateOfBirth.
expected: The response contains the created player data.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

valid_player = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 99,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 99

tests.name: Invalid Date of Birth Format
preconditions: The FastAPI application is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with an invalid dateOfBirth format.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating unprocessable entity.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

invalid_player = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "01-01-1990",
    "squadNumber": 100,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=invalid_player)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "Unprocessable Entity" in response.text
